sources.independence: Primary archival catalogue; catalogue adjacency does not establish person or family continuity. Individual document contents must be inspected.
sources.notes: BNaR catalogue distinguishes I/14 (1591–1592), I/15-a/b (1599 court judgment and 1802 translation), I/18 (1611). The 1611 catalogue title gives the explicit kinship/property statement: Frim son of Bilan sold his Iurghiceni hereditary holding to his nephew Costinovici.
